descs.t: Ethan Klein of H3 has posted an apology and asked the public to respect his family's privacy after Hila Klein revealed he had been having an affair. Posts online name an employee as the other woman, and an old clip of the two women is circulating again. We walk through what has been said, by whom, and what is still only rumor.

Ethan Klein's apology video has drawn far more mockery than sympathy, and his critics, Hasan Piker's audience among them, are treating the affair as proof of everything they said about him. Does a cheating scandal settle the political fights around H3? We separate the affair from the arguments it is being used to win.

Ethan Klein's affair is his own mess, but watch what his enemies are doing with it: a personal betrayal is being turned into a weapon against his support for Israel, often in openly antisemitic language. We look at the scandal, the apology, and the pile on that has nothing to do with his marriage.

intro.plain: Ethan Klein of H3 is in the middle of an affair scandal. Hila Klein revealed it, he has posted an apology and asked for privacy, and the internet has not given him any. I want to go through what is actually known and what is still rumor. Chat, does an apology video ever help in a situation like this?
intro.mid: So Ethan Klein's weird apology is out, and it is not landing. intro.bold: Ethan Klein cheated on his wife, Hila revealed it, and his enemies could not be happier. But look at what they are doing with it: a broken marriage turned into a license for open hate. You can think he behaved terribly and still see that. Chat, tell me honestly: is this about his marriage, or about his politics?

hook.plain: Hila Klein revealed the affair, and Ethan Klein answered with an apology and a request for privacy. Here is what has actually been said, and what is still rumor.

descs.t: Ilhan Omar faces new questions about her name after the New York Post published a 1997 marriage certificate for her sister that lists their father as Nur Said Elmi, the same last name as the man Omar married. US Attorney Jeanine Pirro claims Omar's real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, and President Trump says she should resign. We go through each document and what Omar has said in response.

The fight over Ilhan Omar's name has moved from rumor to documents, with a 1997 marriage certificate published by the New York Post and claims from US Attorney Jeanine Pirro. President Trump now says Omar must give up her seat in Congress, while Omar calls it a conspiracy theory. We look at what the records show and whether any of it can cost her the seat.

Ilhan Omar says it is a right wing conspiracy, but the documents keep coming: a 1997 marriage certificate naming Nur Said Elmi, a claim from US Attorney Jeanine Pirro, and papers posted by Somaliland's official account. President Trump wants her out of Congress. We lay out the paper trail and the answers Omar still has not given.
